pr_title: [ML] use node.roles as node.ml is deprecated in test external cluster
pr_body:
Adjusts the external test cluster settings to use the new `node.roles` settings instead of the
`node.<role_name>: <boolean>` settings.

closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/63553

issue_context.title: [ML] Change ML test setup to use new syntax for specifying node roles
issue_context.body:
Several ML tests now cause lots of deprecation logging due to using the old `node.blah` settings for specifying node roles, for example:

```
[2020-10-12T06:55:37,330][DEPRECATION][o.e.d.c.s.Settings       ] [testTooManyByFields] data_stream.dataset="deprecation.elasticsearch" data_stream.namespace="default" data_stream.type="logs" ecs.version="1.6" key="node.data" message="[node.data] setting was deprecated in Elasticsearch and will be removed in a future release! See the breaking changes documentation for the next major version."
[2020-10-12T06:55:37,330][DEPRECATION][o.e.d.c.s.Settings       ] [testTooManyByFields] data_stream.dataset="deprecation.elasticsearch" data_stream.namespace="default" data_stream.type="logs" ecs.version="1.6" key="node.master" message="[node.master] setting was deprecated in Elasticsearch and will be removed in a future release! See the breaking changes documentation for the next major version."
[2020-10-12T06:55:37,331][DEPRECATION][o.e.d.c.s.Settings       ] [testTooManyByFields] data_stream.dataset="deprecation.elasticsearch" data_stream.namespace="default" data_stream.type="logs" ecs.version="1.6" key="node.ml" message="[node.ml] setting was deprecated in Elasticsearch and will be removed in a future release! See the breaking changes documentation for the next major version."
[2020-10-12T06:55:37,333][DEPRECATION][o.e.d.c.s.Settings       ] [testTooManyByFields] data_stream.dataset="deprecation.elasticsearch" data_stream.namespace="default" data_stream.type="logs" ecs.version="1.6" key="node.ingest" message="[node.ingest] setting was deprecated in Elasticsearch and will be removed in a future release! See the breaking changes documentation for the next major version."
```

These tests (note `testTooManyByFields` is not the only one) should be changed to instead use the `node.roles` array.

review_comments:
`node.data`, `node.master` and `node.ingest` defaulted to `true`.  So previously we were saying that the node had these roles but not `node.ml`.  Does an explicitly empty list mean "use the defaults" or "no roles"?  Either way this appears to be changing the logic:

- If an explicitly empty list means "use the defaults" then we're now defaulting the roles to `master`, `data`, `ingest`, `ml`, and `remote_cluster_client`, i.e. _including_ `ml` when we weren't before
- If an explicitly empty list means "no roles" then that's different to before because `master`, `data`, `ingest`, and `remote_cluster_client` used to default to `true`
Yes, I tested it with an empty list and it seemed to work? I will see whats up. The original external cluster build settings seems to have all default roles set to `false`.

@droberts195 I understood from the beginning that an empty array means "no roles". I thought this was the current behavior given how the base settings looked in `ExternalTestCluster.java` and our updates to them. It seems that "no roles" is what we want. Or at least, how I read it.

The tests obviously passed. So, 🤷
@droberts195 tests pass if a use an empty list or if I supply master, data, and ingest.

> tests pass if a use an empty list or if I supply master, data, and ingest

Oh, is this just for the test client?  I guess we set the roles of the nodes in the cluster somewhere else.  If it's just for the test client then no roles is probably best.
Yeah, this is for `externalClusterClientSettings` so, it's the client :). No roles necessary.
